title: Hostage Call — Commissioner Strand Residence

lines.text: Sup, this is Halden PD Watch Commander. We received a VoIP call from a calm male voice claiming a hostage situation at County Commissioner Ellen Strand’s residence, 123 S. Main St, Halden. The call was not routed to CAD — no ANI, no ALI. The voice was scripted and sounded recorded. We’re patching to LE Liaison now.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This is a swatting inject; the technical team should not initiate a cyber response yet. The LE Liaison must verify the call’s authenticity via field radio and cross-check with the call taker on Position 9.
